publishes: Maven Central app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases-kmp-core, -ui, -models, -mappings, -either, -result (same artifact ids, Kotlin packages stay com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.*)

rules.find: description.set("Mobile subscriptions in hours, not months.")

rules.replace:
id.set("revenuedot")
                        name.set("RevenueDot (fork of RevenueCat's MIT SDK)")
                        url.set("{{homepage}}")

rules.note: native Android SDK from our fork
native iOS source compiled by cinterop comes from our fork
RevenueCat's Play SDK Console tokens do not belong to our coordinates
copyright holder upstream is JayShortway; kept

rules.install: `implementation("app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases-kmp-core:<version>")`. Kotlin packages stay `com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.*`, so imports stay as they are.

pins.note: KMP depends on native Android directly
the iOS submodule's upstream tag; the submodule rule pins it to revenuedot/release-<tag>

checks.name: gradle
checks.run: echo 'SKIPPED: needs JDK 17, the Android SDK and Xcode cinterop (this machine has Java 8). CI runs ./gradlew check.'

checks.name: submodule points at our fork
checks.run: git config -f .gitmodules --get submodule.upstream/purchases-ios.url && git ls-tree HEAD upstream/purchases-ios
